home.heroTitle: Everything your restaurant, café or institution needs — in the right quantity
home.heroSubtitle: Cleaning products, plastics, cups, food packaging and general supplies, priced by the quantity you actually order — from a single carton to a full monthly contract.
home.sectorsSubtitle: From a single café to a multi-branch hospital group.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Pick what fits — buy what you need today, or request a supply quote for larger, recurring needs.
home.shopBody: Browse the catalog, pick quantities, and prices adjust automatically as you order more.
home.supplyBody: Tell us what your restaurant, school or hospital needs and we'll prepare a tailored quotation.
home.depthTitle: Pricing that rewards bulk — the deeper you go, the better the rate
home.depthSubtitle: Every product has clear quantity tiers. Above the top tier, request a custom quote.
home.why1Body: Consistent stock and delivery for recurring institutional needs.
home.why2Body: Clear tiers by quantity — no hidden negotiation for standard orders.
home.why3Body: Payment terms agreed per order or quotation, not a fixed policy.
home.processTitle: How a supply request becomes a delivery
home.process1Body: Tell us the products, quantities and delivery details you need.
home.process2Body: Our sales team reviews your request and proposes pricing and terms.
home.process3Body: Payment terms and delivery schedule are agreed together with you.
home.process4Body: Your order is prepared and delivered as agreed.

about.title: About Atlantis General Supplies
about.intro: Atlantis General Supplies (أطلنتس للتوريدات العموميه) supplies cleaning products, plastic products, cups, restaurant and café essentials, and general supplies to restaurants, cafés, schools, hospitals, universities, companies and institutions across Egypt.
about.missionBody: We combine straightforward online ordering for everyday needs with a dedicated supply-quotation process for larger and recurring institutional orders.
about.repBody: Speak directly with our sales representative for quotations, product questions or supply agreements.
